questions.question: The new policy, which has been widely criticized, is expected to be revised by the government.
options: It is because of the criticism that the policy will be revised.
Since it has been criticized, the government plans to revise it.
Because of the widespread criticism, the policy may not be revised.
The criticism of the policy is what led the government to decide on a revision.
questions.answer: It is because of the criticism that the policy will be revised.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten.
options: When I got there, they were still eating.
I was late, so they finished their meal before my arrival.
It was unfortunate that I missed dinner because of the delay.
The food was cold by the time I sat down.
questions.answer: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten.

questions.question: Unless you apologize to your sister, she will never forgive you.
options: If you don't apologize, your sister might not forgive you.
You should apologize to your sister in order for her to forgive you.
Your sister won't forgive you unless you apologize first.
Apologizing to your sister is the only way to avoid a rift.
questions.answer: Unless you apologize to your sister, she will never forgive you.

questions.question: It was necessary that he should have been more careful.
options: He had to be more careful because it was necessary.
Being more careful would have been a good idea.
If only he had been more careful, this wouldn't have happened.
His carelessness was unfortunate.
questions.answer: It was necessary that he should have been more careful.

questions.question: The fact that she is a good teacher has not been disputed by anyone.
options: Everyone agrees that she is an excellent teacher.
Her teaching skills are widely recognized and respected.
It's true that many people think she's a great teacher, but some have doubts.
There's no denying her exceptional teaching abilities.
questions.answer: The fact that she is a good teacher has not been disputed by anyone.
